title: Milestone 2026.04.39 Retrospective

env_autofix.note: apply_env_autofix() called at retro start; GPU detected; CARNOT_FORCE_LIVE was already set to '0' so auto_fix_applied=false. This is the precise root cause of RETRO-033 miss #7 and is captured as RETRO-053.

retro_039_closure_note: Thesis definitively REJECTED by Exp 516 (GSM-Symbolic adversarial, status=success, honest_verdict=thesis_rejected). RETRO-039 opened because the adversarial robustness claim was unconfirmed; it is now confirmed FALSE. Closed with negative result.
retro_033_new_blocker: CARNOT_FORCE_LIVE env var present but set to '0'. env_autofix.apply_env_autofix() checks for presence (carnot_force_live_was_set=True) and skips injection when the var exists, even when value is '0'. Exp 514 env_autofix shows: gpu_detected=True, carnot_force_live_was_set=True, auto_fix_applied=False, final_env_value='0'. JIT VRAM check (RETRO-051) was successfully implemented and wired (Exp 513), but the live experiment still deferred because CARNOT_FORCE_LIVE='0' is treated as a user-intentional override. Fix: env_autofix must treat '0' as equivalent to not-set when GPU is detected.

adversarial_v5.note: GSM-Symbolic adversarial robustness thesis RAN to completion and was definitively REJECTED. This closes RETRO-039 with a negative result.

new_retro_items.description: env_autofix.apply_env_autofix() treats CARNOT_FORCE_LIVE='0' as a user-intentional override and skips injection (auto_fix_applied=False, final_env_value='0'). The live experiments check CARNOT_FORCE_LIVE truthiness: '0' is treated as disabled. Root cause of RETRO-033 miss #7 and RETRO-038 continued deferral. Fix: in apply_env_autofix(), when gpu_detected=True and os.environ.get('CARNOT_FORCE_LIVE') in (None, '', '0', 'false', 'False'), inject '1'. Override explicit '0' values — the conductor sets this in the live environment; a stale '0' should not block a GPU-attached run.

Batching migration sprint (Exp 518) attempted 20 scripts and migrated 0. The detection pattern found no scripts without BatchedInferenceRunner. Either all scripts already use it (unlikely given known patterns) or the grep pattern is wrong. Manual audit of scripts/ needed. Carry estimated savings of 15-20 min/milestone if migration succeeds.

open_retro_items: RETRO-033 [BLOCKING, MISS #7]: Live 100q verify-repair positive result. JIT VRAM check is wired (RETRO-051 resolved). New blocker: CARNOT_FORCE_LIVE='0' not overridden by env_autofix. Fix: RETRO-053 (env_autofix override of '0' values). This is the single remaining programmatic gate before live benchmarks can execute.
RETRO-038: Live 200q VeriCoT+VPRM statistically significant result. Blocked by same CARNOT_FORCE_LIVE='0' issue as RETRO-033. Will auto-resolve when RETRO-053 is fixed.
RETRO-052: GPU1 compute utilization 0%. Exp 517 confirmed gpu1_compute_pct=0.0 in live_gpu mode. Detection audit and explicit cuda:1 routing required for at least one live script. Target: .40.
RETRO-053 [NEW, CRITICAL]: env_autofix does not override CARNOT_FORCE_LIVE='0'. Must treat '0' as unset when gpu_detected=True. Root cause of RETRO-033 miss #7. Target: .40 experiment 525.
RETRO-054 [NEW, LOW]: Batching migration detection found 0/20 scripts. Pattern redesign required. Target: .40.
closures_achieved_in_39: RETRO-051 CLOSED: JIT VRAM check implemented and wired (Exp 513). Three scenarios validated including retry-with-cooldown on marginal VRAM. The infrastructure fix that was supposed to unblock RETRO-033 is complete.

RETRO-049 CLOSED: NUP Probe v4 contrastive training AUC=1.0 (Exp 523). Correct learning objective identified: energy-gap margin loss (E(incorrect) - E(correct) >= margin) vs BCE boundary classification. Tier 0c promoted.

RETRO-039 CLOSED (negative result): GSM-Symbolic adversarial thesis rejected by full benchmark run (Exp 516). The thesis was that EBM verification is not robust to adversarial numeric perturbations. Exp 516 definitively rejected this claim. Closed as thesis_rejected, not confirmed.

meta_reflection.credibility_verdict: STILL_OPEN after 7 consecutive milestone misses of RETRO-033. The infrastructure is now correct (JIT VRAM check wired, RETRO-051 closed) but a one-line env_autofix bug (treating '0' as user-override instead of falsy) blocked the 7th attempt. This is the most tractable the blocker has ever been: a single conditional in apply_env_autofix() is the last gate.
meta_reflection.wall_time_note: Total milestone wall time 23.0 min, dominated entirely by Exp 516 (22.4 min, GSM-Symbolic adversarial full benchmark). All other experiments combined: 38.5 seconds. The two GPU-required experiments (514, 515) deferred in under 1 second each. When RETRO-033/RETRO-053 are resolved in .40 and live inference runs, expected wall time for Exps 525/526 alone is 30-60 minutes for 100q+200q live benchmarks.

GPU1 utilization at 0% across all live inference experiments. batching_migration_done=False and gpu1_compute_verified=False in .39. Dual-GPU throughput unavailable.
Batching migration detection 0/20 scripts migrated. Framework built but grep pattern missed all candidates. No wall-time savings materialised from the sprint.
top_3_improvements_for_40: Fix RETRO-053 in experiment 525 (env_autofix one-liner). This unblocks RETRO-033, RETRO-038, and RETRO-052 resolution in .40.

Exploit NUP Probe v4 (AUC=1.0) + LeWorldModel JEPA (AUC=0.972, 274x variance reduction) as production-ready components. .40 should wire these into the live verify-repair pipeline to produce real pipeline accuracy numbers.

RETRO-039 thesis definitively REJECTED by full benchmark — this closes a 3-milestone carry with a clear answer, even though the answer is negative.
Hallucination Basin Detector viable at Tier 0d (Exp 521). New detection modality added to the verification stack.
